connection.QXdzVGV4dHJhY3RSZXN0Q2xpZW50..source: A connection to [AWS Textract](https://aws.amazon.com/textract/) for document text and structure extraction via SigV4-signed REST calls.  Inherits all AWS credential modes from AwsRestConnection (static keys, env vars, ECS task-role, IMDSv2, STS AssumeRole). The ping authenticates with `ListAdapters` and requires `textract:ListAdapters`; an authorization denial is reported as a failure.
connection.QXdzVGV4dHJhY3RSZXN0Q2xpZW50..message: Una conexión a [AWS Textract](https://aws.amazon.com/textract/) para la extracción de texto y estructura de documentos mediante llamadas REST firmadas con SigV4. Hereda todos los modos de credenciales de AWS de AwsRestConnection (claves estáticas, variables de entorno, rol de tarea ECS, IMDSv2, STS AssumeRole). El ping autentica con `ListAdapters` y requiere `textract:ListAdapters`; un rechazo de autorización se informa como un error.
